---
title: "Stale evidence"
---

The evidence below was attested against an earlier semantic graph. The
project changed afterwards; its configuration and representation did not.
The envelope still carries the old semantic-graph fingerprint, so
`quarto-needs evidence check` refuses it even though the payload is intact,
the provider still agrees, and nothing has expired.

Approved on the strength of evidence attested against an earlier graph.
:::
